Historically, the Azerbaijani populace faced a lengthy procedure for availing social services, necessitating navigation through myriad bureaucratic channels and paperwork.

By addressing this challenge, the new mechanism streamlined the process, enabling eligible citizens to be automatically enrolled and receive their due benefits in time. Citizens are also informed via SMS notification about the assignment of social payment, the amount and where they can obtain their bank cards. By emphasizing user-centricity, openness and robust stakeholder engagement, the SSPF has markedly enhanced the accessibility and reliability of social services for its citizens and has positioned Azerbaijan at the vanguard of innovative governance, offering a paradigm that stands as a beacon for nations globally.

The introduction of the proactive assignment of social services by the SSPF brought about a radical transformation in the social protection domain of Azerbaijan:

  * In 2019, over 90% of social benefit assignments experienced delays extending from 2-4 months, and in some instances, up to a year from the eligibility date. The proactive assignment system has positively impacted over 600,000 Azerbaijani citizens by automating the distribution of social benefits, reflecting an 80% uptake among the target group. It is important to note that government officials have benefited and witnessed a 60% enhancement in administrative efficiency.

## Innovation Reflections

### Results, Outcomes & Impacts

The new system achieved an 80% uptake with over 600,000 beneficiaries by early 2023, including all pension types and 49 of 51 social allowances and stipends. By 2022, it reduced assignment delays drastically, with 72% of benefits assigned immediately and the rest within 15 days, distributing over USD 4.2 billion and achieving a 94% adequacy rate. Administrative efficiency soared, cutting processing times and operational costs by 60% and 40% respectively, while eliminating 75% of human errors. Digital engagement flourished, with the “e-sosial” web-portal citizen interaction, receiving over 71.8 million interactions. The system expanded to include 15 new payment types by 2022, significantly improving citizen satisfaction.
